title: Currency * currency is a decimal number

source.quote: if a multiplication operation combines an integer with a real number, DAX converts both numbers to real numbers, and the return value is also REAL
source.supports: the Multiplication (*) table of result types: INTEGER*INTEGER is INTEGER, INTEGER*CURRENCY is CURRENCY, CURRENCY*CURRENCY is REAL, CURRENCY*REAL is CURRENCY

source.quote: The only particular case is that when multiplying two numbers of currency data type, the result is a decimal
